layer2.mapping: Operational learning emerges from repeated application of the support queue automation kernel with updated parameters.

primitives.name: User Experience Enhancement Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## User-Facing Value Customers get a clearer, faster, more personalized, more trustworthy product experience.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'X(t)': 'experience quality index at time t, dimensionless', 'P(t)': 'personalization level at time t, dimensionless', 'T(t)': 'trustworthiness score at time t, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Experience quality is a composite of personalization and trustworthiness; P(t) and T(t) are correlated.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When X(t) < threshold, user engagement drops below acceptable levels.

layer2.mapping: User experience enhancement maps to a multi-objective optimization problem where P(t) and T(t) are weighted objectives.
layer2.telemetry: User session duration, task completion rate, and post-interaction survey scores.
